protocol.endpoint_semantics: Primary beetle target is exact 0/1 species detection in the standardized 30 x 30 m insular sampling assemblage. After burned-pilot access only, define one common species universe as beetle species detected (target=1) on at least two distinct frozen pilot islands. Apply that identical fixed species universe to every pilot heldout spatial block and, if later admitted, every confirmatory island. Whole-island occupancy, colonization, rescue and persistence claims are not authorized.

quality_contract.response_quality_semantics: A frozen pilot spatial block is response-qualified only if all pilot islands assigned to that block are represented by the frozen primary beetle response router without confirmatory-island access, the single common pilot-supported species universe has been defined exactly once as species detected on at least two distinct frozen pilot islands, every target admitted to the surface is exact 0/1, and the heldout block retains at least the frozen minimum_test_rows applicable species-by-island targets. Missing/duplicate pilot island rows, response schema drift, any target outside 0/1, inability to construct the common species universe, or fewer than minimum_test_rows applicable targets is a STOP/non-qualified block under the frozen router rules. No island, species, block, threshold, imputation or merge may be changed after pilot opening.

pilot_surface_routing.block: v0.75 spatial block ID for that island
pilot_surface_routing.target: exact 0/1 beetle occurrence cell in the single common pilot-supported species universe
pilot_surface_routing.fixed_species_rule: species with target 1 on at least two distinct frozen pilot islands; compute once from burned pilot and use unchanged for all pilot blocks and all later confirmatory islands

success_ceiling.next_action: freeze a separate response-router/access authorization bound to these exact fingerprints before opening any beetle occurrence value
